subtitle: When Kushan Fire Met Roman Gold

panels.action: Vima Kadphises stands tall in Kushan boots and heavy coat beside a glowing fire altar, one hand resting on a giant gold coin, the hazy trade roads of India and Central Asia stretching behind him.

dialogue.text: In the age when Kushan caravans met Roman bullion, Vima Kadphises struck gold that could speak to four worlds.

i18n.hi: जब कुषाण काफिले रोमन सोने से मिले, वीमा कडफीसिस ने ऐसा सोना गढ़ा जो चार लोक से बातें करे।

panels.action: A vast maplike sweep shows snow-bound passes near Kapisa, the plains around Mathura, and distant sea routes, with tiny caravans and ships threading along the Silk Road and Indian Ocean trade.

dialogue.text: From Kapisa’s cold valleys to Mathura’s river plains, the Kushan realm sat astride the roads of silk, spices and stone.

i18n.hi: कापिशा की ठंडी घाटियों से मथुरा की नदी-भरी धरती तक, कुषाण राज रेशम, मसाले और पत्थर की राहों पर पसरा था।

panels.action: Inside a crowded Kushan court, Vima Kadphises sits on a simple but high-backed throne, heavy coat and boots marking his Central Asian roots, surrounded by Indian advisers and merchants bearing scrolls and balance scales.

dialogue.text: Vima Kadphises, son of nomad kings, now ruled cities and river ports, where merchants counted profit by weight and trust.

i18n.hi: घुमंतू राजाओं का बेटा वीमा कडफीसिस अब शहरों और बंदरगाहों पर राज करता था, जहाँ सौदागर मुनाफा तौल और भरोसे से नापते थे।

panels.action: Close on Vima’s weathered face as he listens to two rival merchants disputing, weighed copper and silver piled between them, a tray of assorted foreign gold pieces lying separate and untouched.

dialogue.text: Silver and copper crossed his borders, and foreign gold too, but every town weighed and guessed by its own rule.

i18n.hi: चाँदी-ताँबा उसकी सरहदें पार करते, परदेसी सोना भी, पर हर शहर अपनी-अपनी तौल से अंदाज़ लगा देता था।

panels.action: An overhead view of a heavy wooden table where Roman-style gold coins, thin Indian pieces, and unmarked nuggets lie in scattered confusion as Vima Kadphises’ hand hovers above them, fingers spread in assessment.

dialogue.text: On his table lay many kinds of gold, bright but faithless, changing value with every hand that touched them.

i18n.hi: उसकी मेज़ पर कई तरह के सोने के टुकड़े थे—चमकदार पर बेवफ़ा, हर हाथ में अपना भाव बदलते।

panels.shot: intimate close-up on hand and scales
panels.action: Vima Kadphises carefully places a thick gold blank onto a balance scale; on the other pan, neat standard weights tip slowly until both sides level, the pointer still in the hushed room.

dialogue.text: The Kushan king turned to the scale. If gold could be bound to a steady weight, trust could travel far.

i18n.hi: कुषाण राजा तराजू की तरफ मुड़ा। अगर सोने को एक सच्ची तौल में बाँधा जाए, तो भरोसा दूर-दूर तक जा सकता है।

panels.action: Inside a royal mint near Purushapura, furnaces glow and craftsmen work; in the center, Vima Kadphises stands by a fire altar, watching molten gold being poured into molds with stern concentration.

dialogue.text: Under Kushan order, furnaces were fed. Gold was melted, measured, and prepared to bear the weight of empire.

i18n.hi: कुषाण हुक्म से भट्टियाँ जल उठीं। सोना गलाया गया, तौला गया, और साम्राज्य का बोझ उठाने को तैयार किया गया।

panels.action: A die engraver’s strong hands position a thick gold blank; behind him, Vima Kadphises looks on as the die showing his standing figure at a fire altar is lowered, seconds before the hammer falls.

dialogue.text: On one side he ordered his own image, standing by the sacred fire, to seal royal promise into metal.

i18n.hi: एक तरफ उसने अपना चेहरा खिंचवाया, पवित्र अग्नि के पास खड़ा, ताकि राज-प्रतिज्ञा धातु में मुहर बन जाए।

panels.shot: slow push-in on reverse of coin
panels.action: A newly struck coin is held up between fingers, its reverse clearly showing Shiva with trident and Nandi, bold and solid, the coin thick and heavy against the dim workshop light.

dialogue.text: On the other, Shiva and Nandi stood, a god of northern India bound to a Central Asian throne.

i18n.hi: दूसरी ओर शिव और नंदी थे—उत्तर भारत का देवता, मध्य एशिया के तख़्त से जुड़ा हुआ।

panels.action: A series of identical Kushan gold coins lie in a neat row on a table; Vima Kadphises oversees as each is tested on scales, the needles settling at nearly the same point every time.

dialogue.text: Piece after piece was checked. Their weight held near eight grams, thick like the aurei crossing the western seas.

i18n.hi: हर टुकड़ा कस कर जाँचा गया। उनका वज़न आठ ग्राम के करीब था, मोटा, पश्चिमी सागर पार करने वाले ऑरेई जैसा।

panels.action: In a grand audience hall, Vima Kadphises presents a tray of his new gold coins to envoys and merchants; some are Central Asian horsemen, others Indian traders in fine cloth, all leaning forward in interest.

dialogue.text: From Kapisa to Mathura, let this gold be one weight and one word.

i18n.hi: कापिशा से मथुरा तक, यह सोना एक ही तौल, एक ही ज़ुबान बने।

panels.action: A quiet view of the Mathura statue of Vima Kadphises being set upright by workers, its inscription stone nearby; the sculpted king stands in boots and coat within the sacred precinct of an Indian temple.

dialogue.text: In Mathura, stone recorded his rule. A Kushan in boots now stood inside an Indian sacred landscape.

i18n.hi: मथुरा में पत्थर ने उसका राज दर्ज कर दिया। जूते पहने एक कुषाण अब भारतीय पवित्र धरती के भीतर खड़ा था।

panels.action: An Indo-Gangetic marketplace shows traders exchanging Vima’s gold pieces for bales of cloth and baskets of spices, Indian and foreign coins lying together but Kushan gold being chosen first.

dialogue.text: His gold began to pass from hand to hand, bridging tongues and measures, trusted because its weight did not lie.

i18n.hi: उसका सोना हाथों से हाथों में जाने लगा, ज़ुबानें और तौल जोड़ता हुआ, भरोसेमंद क्योंकि उसका वज़न झूठ नहीं बोलता था।

panels.action: At a western Indian port, sailors load amphorae and spice sacks; a merchant discreetly hands Kushan gold coins to a middleman near the gangplank of a ship bound toward the west.

dialogue.text: At ports, bullion from the west met Kushan pieces. Gold flowed east for luxuries, but now some flowed back marked by his fire.

i18n.hi: बंदरगाहों पर पश्चिम से आया सोना कुषाण सिक्कों से मिला। सोना विलासिता के लिए पूरब भागता था, पर अब कुछ सोना उसकी आग की मुहर लगाकर लौटने लगा।

panels.action: Inside a Roman counting-house, a serious clerk weighs a mix of eastern gold on scales; nearby, a scroll of Pliny’s complaint lies open, candles burning low in the enclosed room.

dialogue.text: In Rome, men like Pliny grumbled that their gold vanished into eastern hands, drawn by silk, spice and stone.

i18n.hi: रोम में प्लिनी जैसे लोग कुड़कुड़ाते थे कि उनका सोना रेशम, मसाले और पत्थर के लोभ से पूरब के हाथों में गुम हो रहा है।

panels.action: Vima Kadphises walks slowly along a palace courtyard balcony in Purushapura at dusk, looking down at caravans departing with chests of his gold coins, the sky turning copper over the city.

dialogue.speaker: vima_kadphises
dialogue.text: Roads are dust and risk. Gold must be their memory of my word.

i18n.hi: राहें धूल और ख़तरा हैं। सोना ही मेरी बात की याद बने।

panels.action: A scholar’s desk centuries later, covered with trays of Kushan gold coins of Vima Kadphises, annotated diagrams, and die-link charts from modern numismatists studying their sequence by lamplight.

dialogue.text: Long after his courts fell silent, scholars traced his dies and weights, reading history from the metal he bound.

i18n.hi: उसके दरबारों के शांत होने के बहुत बाद, विद्वान उसके साँचे और तौल नापते रहे, उस धातु से इतिहास पढ़ते जिसे उसने बाँधा था।

panels.action: Close up of the Mathura statue’s carved face of Vima Kadphises, softened by age yet clear; in the background, a faint overlay of his coins and trade routes glimmers like a memory.

dialogue.text: Vima Kadphises did not invent gold, but he gave it a steady body for his empire, proving that trust is the hidden metal inside every coin.

i18n.hi: वीमा कडफीसिस ने सोना नहीं खोजा, पर उसने अपने साम्राज्य के लिए उसे स्थिर जिस्म दिया, साबित करते हुए कि हर सिक्के के भीतर छिपा असली धातु भरोसा ही है।

title_i18n.en: Vima Kadphises Strikes the Gold Dinar
title_i18n.hi: वीमा कडफीसिस ने सुनहरा दिनार गढ़ा

subtitle_i18n.en: When Kushan Fire Met Roman Gold
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब कुषाण की आग रोमन सोने से भिड़ी
